A few things to know.

What’s included in the download?+

Each template is a single HTML file with its styles, artwork, and any interactions included. The collection ZIP contains all six templates, an editing guide, and the MIT license.

Can I use these for client projects?+

Yes. The templates and original SVG artwork are released under the MIT license, so you can edit them for personal or commercial projects. Keep the included license notice in your source files.

Do I need to know how to code?+

Basic HTML and CSS knowledge is helpful. You can edit the text directly in any code editor, change the CSS color variables, and open the file in your browser to see the result.

Are checkout and other services included?+

These are front-end starting points with illustrative content. Payments, form delivery, accounts, and other online services need to be connected separately for your project.
